追加固定例：等方散乱平板の反射・透過・吸収。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Su–Olson1996非平衡拡散、Su–Olson1997角度輸送の独立公開表比較。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：2D吸収影と保存的M1輸送、2D反向beamとM1閉包の情報損失。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 別名・表記：放射輸送法 / 区間被覆は有限の固定seedでの観測で、ちょうど95%の実測値や全seedの成功を保証しません。決定論的求積誤差を統計誤差へ含めず、多重散乱・周波数依存・熱輻射・輻射流体連成は未検証です。 今回の追加固定例：有限の4平板に限定。MC、一般角度phase関数、DISORT再現、普遍的次数や厳密連続体誤差境界は認証しません。 Scope and remaining work Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated. Additional fixed examples: Limited to fourfixedisotropic slabs;noMC,generalphase-function/DISORT reproduction,universalorder or rigorouscontinuumerrorbound. Additional fixed examples: This1996diffusion model is distinct from1997angular transport. Original paper fulltext unread;officialsoftware selected values qualified. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator. Additional fixed examples: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport.
